Exercise: Push Up to Side Plank

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- rotational
- push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- upper_body_coordination
- core_stability_and_endurance
- chest_strength_and_size

Contraindications:

- Shoulder injuries
- Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Push Up to Side Plank with Leg Lift, force: push and leg lift, level: advanced, mechanic: compound, equipment: body only
- name: Push Up to Side Plank with Hip Extension, force: push and hip extension, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, equipment: body only

Substitution Options:

- name: Incline Push Up to Side Plank, force: push, level: beginner, mechanic: compound, equipment: body only
- name: Decline Push Up to Side Plank, force: push, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Get into pushup position on the toes with your hands just outside of shoulder width.
- Perform a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex. As you descend, keep your body straight.
- Do one pushup and as you come up, shift your weight on the left side of the body, twist to the side while bringing the right arm up towards the ceiling in a side plank.
- Lower the arm back to the floor for another pushup and then twist to the other side.
- Repeat the series, alternating each side, for 10 or more reps.
